native.title: ForgeaX Kernel (native)
native.hint: The built-in ForgeaX kernel — the default, flagship path. Runs in-process and resolves whatever model credential you configure below (a LiteLLM proxy, or a direct ANTHROPIC / OPENAI / GEMINI key).
native.useReason: Configure a model credential first — a LiteLLM proxy, or an ANTHROPIC / OPENAI / GEMINI key.

api.title: LiteLLM Proxy
api.hint: Point at your LiteLLM proxy: set Base URL + Key. Both the model catalog and the native ForgeaX kernel route through it (the key is mirrored to ANTHROPIC_* so forgeax-core speaks to the proxy).

cli.hint: Detects installed claude-code / codex / cursor-agent / codebuddy / kimi-code / DeepSeek Harness and can run a Test.

memory.label: Memory

kernelPermissions.title: Permission gear per kernel
kernelPermissions.hint: Every kernel starts in "{{mode}}" by default. This only sets the baseline; permissions.deny rules and hook gates still apply.
kernelPermissions.singleGearHint: {{kernel}} supports only this gear — that is its real headless capability. Narrow it with deny rules or hooks instead.
kernelPermissions.denyStillApplies: Even at full access, deny rules, protected paths and PreToolUse hooks still block operations.
kernelPermissions.riskyGearHint: Below full access, {{kernel}} may hang waiting for approval on turns carrying project MCP — a real limitation of that kernel; we no longer silently raise the gear for you.

fork.note: Fork only copies the source directory (incl. prompt / handlers / config). manifest.id is rewritten, displayName gets a "(mine)" suffix. A user-installed copy takes precedence over the built-in copy, so the fork immediately replaces the original in the sidebar.
